transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Meera. How can I assist you today?
Customer: I am extremely frustrated because my internet has been dropping out constantly for the last three days. It is making it impossible to work from home.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you are experiencing these connectivity issues, Emily Reddy. I understand how disruptive that is to your work.
Agent: To look into this for you, could you please provide your account number and date of birth?
Customer: My account number is 38601901 and my phone number is 96309 24082.
Agent: Thank you for that information. I am checking the network status in your area now.
Customer: Please hurry, I have a meeting in an hour and I need a stable connection.
Agent: I see some signal instability on your line. I am going to raise a network ticket for our technical team to investigate the local node immediately.
Customer: Okay, will that fix the drops?
Agent: The ticket will ensure our engineers prioritize the repair of the signal interference. I cannot guarantee an instant fix, but this is the correct step to resolve the instability.
Customer: That sounds like a solid plan, thank you for helping me.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Customer: No, that is all for now.
Agent: Perfect. To summarize, I have raised a network ticket for your connection issues, and our team will be working on it. Thank you for your patience, and have a wonderful day.
